vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype.name: vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype
vehicle_ck_plate_code_subtype.value: (("vehicle"."plate_code" = '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" IS NOT NULL) OR ("vehicle"."plate_code" <> '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" IS NULL))

vehicle_ck_tin_required.name: vehicle_ck_tin_required
vehicle_ck_tin_required.value: (NOT ("vehicle"."plate_code" = '01' OR ("vehicle"."plate_code" = '03' AND "vehicle"."plate_code_subtype" = 'transport_service')) OR NULLIF(BTRIM("vehicle"."tin_number"), '') IS NOT NULL)

driver_operational_profile_ck_presence_a.name: driver_operational_profile_ck_presence_authority
driver_operational_profile_ck_presence_a.value:
(
        (
          "driver_operational_profile"."operational_state" IN ('online', 'offered', 'assigned')
          AND "driver_operational_profile"."owner_session_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM("driver_operational_profile"."presence_session_id"), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND "driver_operational_profile"."presence_generation" > 0
        )
        OR
        (
          "driver_operational_profile"."operational_state" IN ('offline', 'suspended')
          AND "driver_operational_profile"."owner_session_id" IS NULL
          AND "driver_operational_profile"."presence_session_id" IS NULL
        )
      )

ride_request_ck_fare_snapshot_all_or_non.name: ride_request_ck_fare_snapshot_all_or_none
ride_request_ck_fare_snapshot_all_or_non.value:
(
        "ride_request"."fare_estimate_id" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."vehicle_type" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."ride_type" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."currency" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."distance_meters" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."duration_seconds" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."rate_minor_per_km" IS NULL AND
        "ride_request"."estimated_fare_minor" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "ride_request"."fare_estimate_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."vehicle_type" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."ride_type" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."distance_meters" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."rate_minor_per_km" IS NOT NULL AND
        "ride_request"."estimated_fare_minor" IS NOT NULL
      )

dispatch_cancellation_ck_notes_nonempty.name: dispatch_cancellation_ck_notes_nonempty
dispatch_cancellation_ck_notes_nonempty.value: "dispatch_cancellation"."notes" IS NULL OR NULLIF(BTRIM("dispatch_cancellation"."notes"), '') IS NOT NULL

dispatch_cancellation_ck_assignment_requ.name: dispatch_cancellation_ck_assignment_requires_offer
dispatch_cancellation_ck_assignment_requ.value: "dispatch_cancellation"."assignment_id" IS NULL OR "dispatch_cancellation"."offer_id" IS NOT NULL
